summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did before writing this plan:** read-only audit of the full chain — `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `client/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx`, `client/src/App.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, and `client/vite.config.ts`. No edits made.  **Finding, stated plainly:** statically, the chain looks correctly wired, contradicting the ticket's assumption of an obvious wiring bug. - Client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, no localStorage/sessionStorage
